newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury's Summers-EMU stands to benefit U.S..
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury's Summers-EMU stands to benefit U.S..

text.p: Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said the realization of European Monetary Union (EMU) has positive implications for the United States.

"As regards European Monetary Union, as we have said many times before, an increasingly prosperous, increasingly integrated Europe is very much in the United States' interest because Europe is a major market for our products (and) because Europe is a crucial partner for us around the world," Summers said.
He was responding to a question after addressing an Ernst & Young tax conference in New York.
"Therefore, we will be very supportive of Europe in whatever economic strategies it pursues towards prosperity and closer integration," Summers said.
